title: package.json with a Crust build configuration
description: package.json schema for CLIs built with Crust. Point "$schema" at ./node_modules/@crustjs/crust/schema/package.json to get completion for the "crust" block alongside the standard package.json fields.

crust.description: Build configuration read by `crust build`. Every key is optional; unknown keys fail the build. Command names and their source entries come from the standard `bin` field.

runtime.description: Runtime the CLI is built for. Without it: deno.json/deno.jsonc selects deno; @types/node without @types/bun selects node; otherwise bun.

bunPlugins.description: Bun bundler plugin modules applied to Bun and Node builds, in order: bare names resolve from node_modules, paths from the project root; each must default-export the plugin. Rejected for Deno.

include.description: Directories relative to the project root that `crust build` copies into .crust/root/ and into each platform package's bin/.
